main.description: Get a moderation report submitted by the authenticated account to this moderation service.

did.description: Reporter to preview. Defaults to the authenticated account; another account requires an active moderator, triage, or admin credential.

id.description: Report ID (report table ID), as returned by listReports.

resolution.description: Present only when the report is resolved.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No report was found, or the authenticated account did not submit it.

src.description: DID of the moderation service that received the report.

id.description: Report ID (report table ID), used by Ozone's report detail page.

reasonType.description: The exact fully-qualified reason NSID submitted with and stored on the report.

record.description: Raw record JSON for the subject, when the subject is a record and the record is available.

accountStatus.description: Current status of the reported account or record owner, independent of the report's resolution.

subjectStatus.description: Current status of a reported record, when known.

enforcement.description: Current enforcement by this moderation service.

hosting.description: Last known account hosting state, omitted when unknown.

takendown.description: Whether this moderation service has taken down the record.

deleted.description: Whether the record has been deleted by its repository, omitted when unknown.

actionTaken.description: Public action associated with this report's resolution. See the public action vocabulary table.
